quirks: anthropic 0.94.0 supports output_config={'format': {'type': 'json_schema', 'schema': ...}} on messages.create directly - no beta header needed, no tool-forcing workaround required.

The schema must NOT use minimum/maximum on number properties: the API 400s with "For 'number' type, properties maximum, minimum are not supported" (verified). Confidence range is therefore validated client-side in voteschema.parse_vote.

The JSON arrives as a single ordinary text content block; the existing next((b.text for b in content if b.type=='text'), '') extraction works unchanged, returning '' when no text block exists (e.g. stop_reason=max_tokens with the budget consumed) - which downstream maps to abstain(parse_failure).
The model volunteered abstain=true when it declined - the explicit-abstain path works natively.
